description: T-4130: does Excel for the web open and apply each fixed date filter type of a pivot? Data!A1:B14 has Date (m/d/yyyy, DATE formulas, so the builder caches them as missing: with literal dates cached as numbers Excel drops a dateEqual filter, DLit; pivots.md) and Sales: one date per month of 2024 (45306 + 31k, 1/15/2024 to 12/21/2024) with Sales 1 to 12, then 1/10/2025 (45667) with 13. Each sheet is one builder-v2 pivot at A3, rows Date, Sum of Sales, with one `<filter fld="0">`: DEq dateEqual 45399 (4/17/2024); DNe dateNotEqual it; DOld dateOlderThan it; DOldEq dateOlderThanOrEqual it; DNt dateNewerThan 45492 (7/19/2024); DNte dateNewerThanOrEqual it; DBt dateBetween the two; DNbt dateNotBetween them; M1 to M12 the month filters and Q1 to Q4 the quarter filters (dynamicFilter); DWd dateEqual 45399 with the x15 pivotFilter extension useWholeDay 1; DLit dateEqual 45399 over Lit!A1:B14, the same dates as literal numbers (m/d/yyyy), which the builder caches as `<n>` items. Pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 makes the case scored.
